title: Rav Shmuel of Tuach
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Niddah 33a relates that Rav Papa came to Bei Tuach and asked: “Is there a young scholar here whom I may enter and greet?” An old woman answered: “There is a young scholar here, named Rav Shmuel, who recites baraitot. May you be like him!” Rav Papa inferred that he was God-fearing and went to see him. Rav Shmuel slaughtered an ox in his honor, then asked Rav Papa about two contradictory mishnayot. Rav Papa answered: “Here we are dealing with a Samaritan who observes the purity laws.” He replied: “Would you make such a Samaritan a man who has intercourse with a menstruant?” Rav Papa left and came before Rav Shimi bar Ashi, who asked why he had not answered him, etc.

notes.text: The departure, greeting, blessing, Rav Papa antecedents and standard question formulae are translated from the connected Hebrew. The requested Niddah response was unavailable, so no primary-passage confirmation is claimed.

A fresh named witness was read in the consulted Niddah 33b, including the greeting, blessing, Rav Shmuel, ox, Samaritan objection and departure to Rav Shimi bar Ashi. Hyman’s supplied 33a is preserved. The retained earlier note records the earlier unavailable response; it does not describe the fresh successful reading.
